paragraphs: Stony Brook University is a flagship public research university of the State University of New York (SUNY) system, founded in 1957 and located on Long Island, approximately 80 km east of Manhattan. It is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities (AAU) and consistently ranks among the top public universities in the United States, with US News & World Report placing it as the highest-ranked public university in New York State.

The university partners with INTO University Partnerships to provide pathway programs that prepare international students for direct entry into Stony Brook's undergraduate and graduate degree programs. The INTO Stony Brook centre offers Academic English, Undergraduate Pathway, Undergraduate Transfer, and Graduate Pathway programs across Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Health Sciences, Life Sciences, and more.

Stony Brook is a major research powerhouse with strong programs in Marine Sciences, Computer Science, Physics, and Medicine. It co-manages Brookhaven National Laboratory with Battelle, providing students with access to world-class research facilities including the Simons Center for Geometry and Physics and the Laufer Center for Physical and Quantitative Biology.

The 1,454-acre campus is the largest public university by area in New York State and hosts over 27,000 students from more than 100 countries. Students benefit from Long Island's coastal setting while remaining within easy reach of New York City for internships, cultural experiences, and career opportunities.
paragraphsRu: Stony Brook University — флагманский государственный исследовательский университет системы State University of New York (SUNY), основан в 1957 году и расположен на Лонг-Айленде, примерно в 80 км к востоку от Манхэттена. Член престижной Association of American Universities (AAU); по версии US News & World Report стабильно входит в топ public universities США и занимает первое место среди public-университетов штата Нью-Йорк.

Университет сотрудничает с INTO University Partnerships для подготовки международных студентов к прямому поступлению на bachelor- и master-программы Stony Brook. INTO Stony Brook centre предлагает Academic English, Undergraduate Pathway, Undergraduate Transfer и Graduate Pathway по направлениям Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Health Sciences, Life Sciences и другим.

Stony Brook — крупный исследовательский центр с сильными программами в Marine Sciences, Computer Science, Physics и Medicine. Совместно с Battelle управляет Brookhaven National Laboratory; студентам доступны лаборатории мирового уровня — Simons Center for Geometry and Physics и Laufer Center for Physical and Quantitative Biology.

Кампус площадью 1,454 акра — крупнейший public-кампус в штате Нью-Йорк, здесь учатся более 27 000 студентов из 100+ стран. Студенты получают преимущества coastal-расположения Long Island и при этом находятся в часе езды от Нью-Йорка — стажировки, культурные события и карьерные возможности.
